messages:
Olivia (People Ops): Quick sync for Noor (start Mon 9/6). She's UK-based so remote I-9 process differs. Need to confirm right-to-work docs, bg check timeline, laptop shipping, and payroll tax forms. Who can pick tasks?
Ken (HR): For UK hires we handle eligibility via local docs instead of I-9. Noor will upload passport + BRP (biometric residence permit) or right-to-work share code. I'll DM the secure upload link.
onboard-bot: Secure upload link sent to noor@example.co.uk  expires in 7 days. Background check vendor (GlobalVerify) notified.
Noor (newhire): Thanks! I have passport and BRP. Quick Q: will payroll need a UK NI number right away? I'm in process of applying.
Ken (HR): Payroll can onboard without NI temporarily but will need it for tax & NI withholding. They'll send a conditional payroll form. Please upload provisional docs and update NI when you have it.
infra-ops: We can ship laptop internationally via DHL. Need shipping address and preferred delivery days (avoid weekends). ETA 4-6 business days.
Noor (newhire): Shipping address: 12 Vicarage Road, London, SW1A 2AA. Weekdays only please. Also will need VPN & repo access on Day 1.
Jules (Hiring Manager): Add Noor to eng-uk, repo-read, and onboarding Slack channel on day 1. No on-call for first month. Please also schedule intro 1:1 Tue morning.
Olivia (People Ops): Action list: Ken = collect docs + bg-check follow-up; infra-ops = ship laptop DHL weekdays; Payroll = conditional onboarding without NI; Jules = add to teams + schedule 1:1.
onboard-bot: BG check status: "pending". Typical turnaround 48-72 hrs. Reminder if not complete in 48h.
Noor (newhire): Uploaded passport & share code. Cheers! Looking forward to start. :smile:
Ken (HR): Received. Scheduling remote eligibility verification Thu 09:00 GMT. We'll use video call for document review. If anything flags on background check I'll alert security + hiring manager.
infra-ops: Shipment created: carrier DHL, tracking GB1234567890. Delivery expected Thu.
Olivia (People Ops): All set from ops side. Noor, please complete payroll provisional form within 3 days to ensure first run. Welcome aboard! :tada:
